# Stamp footer text: AlbumEasy 4.5.0 reference

This is an AlbumEasy-only reference fixture for GitHub issue
[#94](https://github.com/amhbamhb/StampAlbumGen2/issues/94). The AlbumEasy
PDFs are the accepted behavioral references; they remain distinct from the
native-renderer proof PDFs. Standalone native rendering now supports this
command slice through both the AlbumEasy compatibility parser and explicit
`STAMPALBUM 1` input. Production routing remains deferred until all required
AlbumEasy stamp commands are mapped.

## Coverage

| Input | Cases |
|---|---|
| [alignment.txt](alignment.txt) | Default and explicit `ALIGN`; `CENTRE` and `CNR_CENTRE`; US aliases `CENTER` and `CNR_CENTER`; explicit `ALIGN` reset |
| [padding-state.txt](padding-state.txt) | Default/zero, +6 mm and -1 mm padding; multiline captions with `TEXT_LINE_LEADING (0)`; `ALIGN`/zero snapshot, temporary `CENTRE`/+3 and `CNR_CENTRE`/-1 settings, then restored state |

Each AlbumEasy reference PDF contains two complete US Letter pages and 12
real image placements (six per page). Both reuse the verified 40 x 26 mm and
50 x 40 mm stamp images from `../stamp-pagination-v1/`; each frame adds 6 mm
total. The padding proof uses 4 mm horizontal and 10 mm vertical page spacing
to keep the case labels and negative-padding captions legible.

The checked-in `native-alignment.pdf` and `native-padding-state.pdf` are
generated by the standalone compatibility renderer from the matching TXT
inputs. They are implementation proofs, not AlbumEasy references. The explicit
native-format proof is [footer-text.stampalbum](../../native_pdf/stamp-footer-text-v1/footer-text.stampalbum)
with [footer-text-native.pdf](../../native_pdf/stamp-footer-text-v1/footer-text-native.pdf);
it covers heading and footer attachments on the same stamp.

## Reproduction

Requires the local AlbumEasy 4.5.0 launcher at
`/home/ray/work/AlbumEasy/AlbumEasy.sh`. From this fixture directory on Linux:

```sh
timeout 60s xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x1024x24' \
  env QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb /home/ray/work/AlbumEasy/AlbumEasy.sh -c alignment.txt
timeout 60s xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x1024x24' \
  env QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb /home/ray/work/AlbumEasy/AlbumEasy.sh -c padding-state.txt
```

Both final commands exited 0 and created their adjacent reference PDFs.
Regenerate the native compatibility PDFs with
`cargo test --test native_pdf_albumeasy generate_native_footer_compatibility_proof_pdfs -- --ignored`.
Regenerate the explicit native-format proof with
`cargo test --test native_pdf_album generate_native_footer_review_pdf -- --ignored`.
Validate the PDFs with:

```sh
pdfinfo alignment.pdf
pdfinfo padding-state.pdf
pdfimages -list alignment.pdf
pdfimages -list padding-state.pdf
pdfinfo native-alignment.pdf
pdfinfo native-padding-state.pdf
pdfinfo ../native_pdf/stamp-footer-text-v1/footer-text-native.pdf
pdftotext -layout alignment.pdf -
pdftotext -layout padding-state.pdf -
```

Both AlbumEasy PDFs report 2 pages at 612 x 792 pt (US Letter);
`pdfimages -list` reports 12 image placements in each. The native
compatibility proofs are checked for matching page/image counts by integration
tests. Complete-page rasters of the AlbumEasy references were generated
outside the repository in the session workspace and visually inspected.
Text extraction confirms the section labels, captions, and `Page 1 of 2` /
`Page 2 of 2` footers. The accepted reference pages have no clipped captions
or overlapping case labels.

## Run history and evidence

An initial render attempt was launched from the repository root instead of
this directory; it exited 1 with `File:padding-state.txt not found`. Rerunning
from the fixture directory succeeded. Visual inspection also caught crowded
case labels and captions in an earlier padding layout. The fixture was
adjusted to 10 mm vertical spacing, a one-line opening label, and -1 mm
negative padding; the final pages were rerendered and inspected. No production
source or configuration was changed.

Filesystem impact: the reference fixture contains its two TXT inputs, two
AlbumEasy reference PDFs, two standalone compatibility-renderer PDFs, and this
README. The explicit native input and its proof live in the adjacent native
fixture folder. Complete-page previews are outside the repository. No files
were deleted or relocated. Database impact: none; no database was opened or
changed. No source assets were modified.

The #94 mapping and standalone renderer checks cover signed padding, all
alignment modes and aliases, save/restore, native and compatibility input, and
output preservation for invalid input. `TEXT_LINE_LEADING (0)` is accepted as
the default reset required by these examples; nonzero leading remains an
explicitly reported unsupported command rather than being silently ignored.
Production routing is still deferred. Windows execution and actual-size print
review are not yet performed.
